rules: Approve only the event type a trustworthy captured SGF explicitly attributes, supported by professional evidence for the type and its boundaries; GN and GC are one correlated internal evidence chain.
A professional source need not independently reproduce every player pairing when no actual event-type ambiguity or contradiction exists.
Non-type date, edition, round, stage, board, result or rank problems remain unresolved; do not fill or correct them under type-only approval. Do not label a whole record fully verified.

A contradiction affecting country, competition identity, gender/age/amateur category, eligible population, or evidence that GN belongs to a different game requires HOLD and targeted external resolution.
Generic text or a filename alone is insufficient. Do not create global aliases for dates, filenames, 团体赛, numbered snippets, or entire filename families.

Only listed album_id + exact raw + source_path + SGF SHA are semantically allowlisted. New live manifests must assert event_id=NULL and event_edition_id=NULL, source root-property equality and environment-specific target identity, then dry-run/apply without adding extra albums.
TEST must independently match the PROD-derived album manifest and catalog. Missing/drifting rows stay HOLD; do not assume numeric IDs or content coincide.

Do not globally approve raw-event staging rows whose exact raw is shared by unreviewed/different-type games. Type-only approval belongs to the exact album scope; preserve field-specific limitations in evidence metadata.
New canonical 中国全国围棋段位赛 is the documented parent competition only; this does not merge its 定段/升段 subgroups or assign either group, edition or round.
No event editions, aliases, translations or source SGF edits are approved in this type-only operation. Five-language translation remains paused.
